facts.claim: P/B 1.374x at the 94.35th own-history percentile (V1); price $56.70; priced-in ROE 12.03%; fair P/B at 12% ROE ~1.37x "almost exactly today's multiple"
facts.source: 8-K Ex-99.1 -26-000353 (book value per common share $39.34, tangible BVPS $29.37, common shares 7.02bn, total shareholders' equity $301.7bn); d4 snapshot y_priceToBook 1.441
facts.source_value: P/B on common book = 56.70 / 39.34 = 1.44x; P/TBV = 1.93x. V1 divides market cap on weighted diluted shares ($413.6bn) by TOTAL equity including preferred ($301bn) = 1.374x. Corrected priced-in ROE under the same justified-P/B formula = 0.03 + 1.441 x (0.0958 - 0.03) = 12.5%
facts.note: The dossier's P/B (inherited from V1) uses total equity incl. preferred and a diluted-weighted market cap: 1.374x understates the common P/B by 5%. At 1.44x the stock is already at the dossier's own kill threshold (P/B >1.45x) and ~5% above the "fair 1.37x at 12% ROE". On the bank-appropriate P/TBV-ROTCE method: justified P/TBV = (ROTCE - g)/(COE - g) = (17.0% - 3%)/(9.58% - 3%) = 2.13x at 2Q26 ROTCE, 1.92x at the 15.6% four-quarter average ROTCE (3Q25 15.4, 4Q25 14.0, 1Q26 16.0, 2Q26 17.0) vs actual 1.93x. implied_vs_base = in_line retained (priced ROE 12.5% vs 12.0% base vs 12.7% latest) but it leans slightly above; verdict INCLUDE-SMALL unchanged.
